method: LEACE (LEAst-squares Concept Erasure), official concept-erasure package
citation: Belrose, Schneider-Joseph, Ravfogel, Cotterell, Raff, Biderman. LEACE: Perfect linear concept erasure in closed form. NeurIPS 2023 (Advances 36)
pinned_version: PyPI 0.2.4 (2024-01-10; latest release); repo HEAD 9f51753821316a1edacf78b52b464ab26d40e60a (2024-10-15); pyproject on main says 0.2.5 (unreleased). PCRL/DG requirements say only concept-erasure>=0.2.0 (unpinned); PCRL .venv has 0.2.4 installed
input_type: any fixed representation vectors (streaming fitter supported)
supervision_required: protected labels z at fit only; none at deploy (affine map)
protected_attr_assumptions: z is any k-dim vector: one-hot categorical, continuous, or concatenation of several attributes
task_supervision_decoder: no task labels; guarantee concerns linear predictors with convex loss
exposes: erased representation r(x)=x-P(x-mu); projection matrix available
stated_guarantee: Thm 3.1: linear guardedness iff Cov(r(X),Z)=0 (class-conditional means equal); LEACE is the least-squares-minimal affine eraser achieving it; holds for the moments used to fit (empirical fitting sample in practice)
not_guaranteed: nonlinear recovery; held-out rows or shift; refit-on-evaluation-rows linear probes; downstream task outputs; package defaults (svd_tol=0.01 truncation, constrain_cov_trace mixing with orthogonal projection) may leave trace correlation (docstring; code-read; not triggered in 700 synthetic fixture trials, methods/SUMMARY.md)
native_purpose_coalition_support: joint erasure of several attributes via concatenated z (native); no per-recipient/per-purpose notion
feasible_adaptation: (i) separate per-recipient LEACE fit on each recipient's declared sensitive set; (ii) single joint LEACE on the union of all declared sets (one shared release); (iii) PCRL embeds it as warm-start/erase layer
adaptation_changes_claim: no for (i)/(ii): guarantee is per fitted z; concatenating releases erased against the SAME attribute keeps Cov=0 (block identity) but an attribute disallowed for one recipient and allowed/unerased for another is not protected against the coalition
existing_results_durable_guarantees: post-hoc on clean task-trained P, 3 headline cells x3 seeds (baseline_gauntlet.py:309-323): Tier-1 AUC 0.995/0.997/0.998 at 101/97/82% utility; fails everywhere (results/baseline_gauntlet.json; master_gauntlet_table.txt)
existing_results_pcrl: rlace_diagnostic (f8d1966cf, results/rlace_diagnostic.md:13-59): Adult 8 pairs, test R2 0.004-0.009; LEACE-on-raw (results/LEACE_SUMMARY.md) 0/20 with test-refit R2 0.95-0.999 - UNAUDITED/suspect (sequential chain, rank-deficient one-hots, in-sample-on-test R2); ACS leace_A0 (invariant-baselines@73903b7) indistinguishable from J on 5 endpoints.
